extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: Keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan options with the customer, but the disclaimer was delivered after the benefits discussion, which is non-compliant.
composition.coaching_note: The agent should ensure the disclaimer is read before discussing any benefits to comply with CMS rules. For example, the agent could say, 'Before we discuss the benefits, I need to inform you that we do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.'
